items.title: Ralph Emerson Brown and Jasper Taylor Interview, 1961-05-23
items.q: Johnny Dodd. Johnny Dodd was a great soloist by himself, a high enough man.

ctx.x: An awful lot of clarinets came out of New Orleans.

Oh yes. Johnny Dodd. Johnny Dodd was a great soloist by himself, a high enough man. Now Bonnie and Bonnie, and Nichols, they were a great team because they played together. And I didn't know that they told me that Bonnie was a fellow that really knew the music. Nichols, they say he wasn't a great reader but I mean he was a great technique. But he and Bonnie played together. He was about the first of the real good clarinets teams. And they played saxophone too. That saxophone was mostly the instrument with Joe…
Where has Hawkins been in? He was around Chicago for about a while.
